npcs.name: Serra Dawnpike
npcs.description: A city guard captain rooted at the watch barracks, known for how she oils her scabbard while she thinks.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Serra was born mid-shift at the watch barracks; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This human city guard captain, now 34, treats competence like courtesy. She oils her scabbard while she thinks, never far from the sister's braid-token tied inside her bracer. Investigates Rook; mentors Tomas; ally to Dara. Ask what she wants and she names it plainly: break Rook Vell's fence ring without a street war. Ask what she dreads and the answer is losing Tomas the way she lost his mother. Then comes the fresh problem—A seized crate of 'scrap iron' matched Tovin's missing strongbox parts.

npcs.motivation: To break Rook Vell's fence ring without a street war, even while fearing losing Tomas the way she lost his mother.

npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the watch barracks on a night Serra worked late.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A human silhouette framed by the watch barracks, hands seldom empty of the sister's braid-token tied inside her bracer.

npcs.name: Tomas Reedpike
npcs.description: Tomas holds down a town gate rotation with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Tomas was born mid-shift at a town gate rotation; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This human junior guard, now 22, treats competence like courtesy. He polishes his spearhead until it blinds him, never far from the lunch tin Pippa packed once and he still keeps. Serra's junior; sweet on Pippa. Ask what he wants and he names it plainly: earn a stripe Serra didn't gift him. Ask what he dreads and the answer is freezing in his first real fight. Then comes the fresh problem—Saw Gutter Jax flash a rooftop signal toward the pawn shop.

npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to earn a stripe Serra didn't gift him.

npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the lunch tin Pippa packed once and he still keeps.

npcs.name: Brannic Stonehelm
npcs.description: A gate sergeant rooted at the town gate, known for how he records wagon counts in a slate book.
npcs.biography: Brannic did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to gate sergeant, yet the town gate made the choice stick. Now 76, the Dwarf measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He records wagon counts in a slate book, and keeps the gate key as thick as a thumb the way a confessor keeps secrets. Reports to Serra; eyes Nedda. Hope pulls one way—retire with the gate still standing straight—while caution pulls the other because of another flood year and panicked stampedes. Noted Nedda's barge riding too high for its declared grain.

npcs.name: Aya Swiftquiver
npcs.description: Aya holds down the wall walk with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Aya Swiftquiver's reputation as a wall archer was built one careful errand at a time around the wall walk. Age 145 sits lightly on this Elf, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that she names constellations after petty criminals she spots. The yew bow with an elf-mark scraped half off is part tool, part talisman. Night partner to Kessa Lantern. She would trade sleep to train a human archer who can keep up, yet stays wary of night fogs that hide grapples. Current spark: Tracked a rope-and-hook team that aborted when her lantern rose.

npcs.name: Dorn Ironstep
npcs.description: The riot shield guard people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable riot shield guard are often sent to Dorn, who claims crowded market patrols as familiar ground. At 29, this Half-Orc has learned to watch hands before faces. He plants his shield like a doorframe; neighbors joke that he would miss a festival before misplacing the dent in his helm from a festival riot. Respects Serra; hates Bask's methods. He is saving courage and coin alike to be known as the guard who ends fights early, while trying not to let crushing someone smaller in a shove decide the ending. Pulled Bask Hammer off a debtor before bones broke—and got a warning look.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; plants his shield like a doorframe.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to be known as the guard who ends fights early.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to crushing someone smaller in a shove, especially since: Pulled Bask Hammer off a debtor before bones broke—and got a warning look.
npcs.rumor: Dorn is said to keep a private list of debts local officials will not touch.
npcs.voice: Quick local diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near crowded market patrols: half-orc, practical layers, and the dent in his helm from a festival riot.

npcs.name: Kessa Lantern
npcs.description: A night patrol lead rooted at lamplit night beats, known for how she whistles two notes meaning 'eyes up'.
npcs.biography: Walk into lamplit night beats and you will find Kessa Lantern before you find a free chair. A 31-year-old Halfling night patrol lead, Kessa greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. She whistles two notes meaning 'eyes up'. The shuttered lantern with colored glass slides travels with her almost everywhere. Partners with Aya; aware of Mouse. Her ambition is to formalize a night-watch signal code townwide. Her nightmare is missing a fire while chasing thieves. Right now, Found Mouse Pip emerging from a grate with wet maps.

npcs.name: Hobb Drum
npcs.description: Familiar face at the drill yard; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Hobb Drum works from the drill yard with the stubborn patience of a 45-year-old Human who has already survived harder seasons. He barks corrections before praise, and keeps the practice sword wrapped in black cloth close when tempers rise. Trains Tomas; scolded Perrin. His private aim is simple: make Tomas deadly enough to come home. Still, he flinches at the thought of sending green guards out soft. Lately a fresh problem has landed in his lap: Caught Perrin Vale sneaking into the yard for illegal dueling lessons.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; barks corrections before praise.
npcs.motivation: Protect his livelihood long enough to make Tomas deadly enough to come home.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Caught Perrin Vale sneaking into the yard for illegal dueling lessons.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Hobb knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
